purpose: Deterministically construct an explainable Protocol 7 roll pool without a generic bonus-die channel.

input.ability_dice: three dice resolved from skill registry and character state

pipeline.rule: Convert ranks to exactly one ordinary Skill die using core breakpoints; never progress beyond d12.
Add the three Ability dice named by the canonical Skill record, preserving duplicate Ability references.
Add only legal relevant Gear dice. Default primary relevant gear limit is one unless an explicit rule overrides it.
Apply only explicit VAM operations. VAM-added dice retain source_type=vam and are not renamed Advantage.
Expand active Condition effects into named restrictions and/or Advantage/Disadvantage sources. Legacy condition die labels do not create alternate A/D die sizes.

Count named Advantage and Disadvantage reasons. Cancel reasons one-for-one. If one or more Advantage reasons remain, apply exactly one effective Advantage: add one d6. If one or more Disadvantage reasons remain, apply exactly one effective Disadvantage: remove the smallest Ability die in the pool for that roll. Same-side reasons do not stack unless an explicit rule specifically overrides the cap.
If and only if the Skill is Mastered and an explicit legal access mechanism grants access, add one Mastery die equal to the current ordinary Skill die.

Every added die must have source_type, source_id/reason, die size, and mechanical role. Every removed die must identify the source and removed Ability. Reject unexplained dice and numeric +N modifiers.
Show the player every surviving die grouped by Skill, Ability, Gear, VAM, Advantage, and Mastery, plus any removed Ability die and the reason for its removal.

hard_failures: gear die with no relevant gear source
Disadvantage implemented as an added penalty die
audit_note: r002 synchronizes the evaluator to the v0.188 playtest A/D rule. Conditions and VAMs may create named A/D reasons, but they do not redefine the universal A/D operation unless an explicit higher-authority rule says so.
